node.title: Re: Reflected XSS All Clients
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Three problems with the code you showed: 1. It doesn't compile. 2. /^[^0-9]$/ only tests whether the string consists of a single character that is not a digit. I assume you meant /[^0-9]/. 3. When an input contains an invalid value, all you do is print an additional line of output, you probably meant [doc://die] instead of [doc://print].

In addition, to prevent XSS attacks, you should use a module to escape any strings you're inserting into the output.
